summary: Markets bounced back on Wednesday following a three-day losing streak, as they shook off rising yields and higher oil prices. The Nasdaq Composite and the S&P 500 both gained 0.5%. Wednesday’s rebound doesn’t have any real “fundamental justification,” says José Torres, senior economist at Interactive Brokers.
